title: Object stuck in the body (impaled)
scenario: Glass, metal, rebar, or wood sticking out of the body after the earthquake. Impaled object in stomach, chest, or limb.
steps: Leave the object in place — it may be plugging the wound.
Stabilize it: pack bulky cloth or dressings around the object so it cannot shift.
Control bleeding with firm pressure AROUND the object, never on it.
Keep the person as still as possible and treat for shock: lying down, kept warm.
For small splinters just under the skin, ordinary removal is fine — this guidance is for deeply embedded objects.
do_not: Never pull a deeply embedded object out — removal can cause massive bleeding.
Do not press directly on the object or lean on it.
